shared_contract.unknown_data_rule: Show unknown or unavailable explicitly; never convert missing data to zero, closed or verified.
shared_contract.sponsored_rule: Show Sponsored and Lao advertising text before the decision action; payment does not alter rating or trust.
shared_contract.external_action_rule: Map, Call, Message and Original Source are external handoffs with unavailable/failure fallback.

screens.name: Discovery Feed
screens.primary_outcome: Open a decision-ready Place or an external action from a video-led discovery item.
acceptance: One primary item per mobile viewport
Trust/source is readable without opening Place
Unavailable media is not a dead end
Each action has a separate 44px target

screens.name: Search & Filters
screens.primary_outcome: Find and compare a Place by intent, category, location, price and availability.
acceptance: Query and filters survive view changes and retry
Selected state is programmatically exposed
Empty differs from Error
Sponsored is separated from organic similarity

screens.name: Place Decision
screens.primary_outcome: Decide whether to visit using facts, reviews, category details, freshness and contact actions.
acceptance: Decision facts precede promotional detail
Menu/room/category items include image, name, price and checked date when available
Unavailable action includes a reason
Back returns to prior Search/Feed context

screens.name: Consent & Privacy
screens.primary_outcome: Choose essential-only or optional analytics and change the choice later.
acceptance: Essential-only and analytics choices have equal prominence
Declining analytics does not block core use
Initial focus and dialog structure are accessible
Save failure preserves the choice

screens.name: Operations Queue
screens.primary_outcome: Select the next Place or Trust task by priority, SLA and assignment.
acceptance: P0/P1 and overdue items are not communicated by color alone
Unauthorized state exposes no queue data
Filters remain after refresh
Keyboard order follows queue reading order

screens.name: Place Editor
screens.primary_outcome: Edit Place data against source evidence and submit a publish-ready version.
acceptance: Field and evidence remain visible together on desktop
Validation summary focuses the first error
Conflict never silently overwrites newer data
Unsaved input is preserved after recoverable failure

screens.name: Moderation Case
screens.primary_outcome: Apply a policy-based decision with evidence, reason code and auditable timeline.
acceptance: Decision requires policy and reason code
Restricted evidence is never exposed to unauthorized roles
Every state change creates an audit event
Appeal reviewer differs from the original decision maker
